BackstoryDef.title: vault protocol pupil
BackstoryDef.description: Raised beneath reinforced blast doors where every rule was engraved on brass plaques, [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that obedience kept the air filters humming. [PAWN_pronoun] excelled at memorizing vault regulations and reporting classmates who strayed from schedules.

BackstoryDef.title: authoritarian vault overseer
BackstoryDef.description: Ruling [PAWN_possessive] subterranean domain with absolute authority, [PAWN_nameDef] believes strict isolation is the only shield against surface anarchy. Stubborn, paternalistic, and quick to deploy security batons, [PAWN_pronoun] guards vault secrets at any cost.

BackstoryDef.title: subterranean clinic aide
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up in an isolated underground community with scarce medical supplies, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth assisting vault doctors and mediating disputes between cramped quarters. [PAWN_pronoun] developed a calm, diplomatic demeanor under pressure.

BackstoryDef.title: pragmatic council overseer
BackstoryDef.description: Elected to lead after stabilizing an internal crisis, [PAWN_nameDef] balances strict vault traditions with cautious surface trade. Poised, perceptive, and protective of [PAWN_possessive] citizens, [PAWN_pronoun] uses diplomacy to keep Vault-Tec's surviving enclaves unified.

BackstoryDef.title: eccentric child genius
BackstoryDef.description: Obsessed with virtual simulations and behavioral puzzles from childhood, [PAWN_nameDef] preferred manipulating miniature worlds over playing with other children. [PAWN_possessive] brilliant mind was matched only by an alarming lack of empathy.

BackstoryDef.title: societal experiment architect
BackstoryDef.description: Creator of the G.E.C.K. and chief architect of Vault-Tec's most twisted social experiments, [PAWN_nameDef] views human subjects as toys inside a grand laboratory. Charming yet utterly sadistic, [PAWN_pronoun] treats survival protocols like an endless game.

BackstoryDef.title: door-to-door hustler
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in a modest pre-war suburb, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth hawking newspapers and polishing [PAWN_possessive] cheerful sales pitch on busy street corners. [PAWN_pronoun] firmly believed a bright smile and a company clipboard could open any door.

BackstoryDef.title: veteran corporate salesman
BackstoryDef.description: Left outside the blast doors on the day the bombs fell despite decades of loyal service, [PAWN_nameDef] miraculously survived the apocalypse through sheer stubbornness. Still clutching [PAWN_possessive] pre-war enthusiasm, [PAWN_pronoun] talks [PAWN_possessive] way through wasteland deals with practiced charm.

BackstoryDef.title: corridor patrol cadet
BackstoryDef.description: Trained from adolescence to guard airlocks and break up cafeteria scuffles, [PAWN_nameDef] took immense pride in [PAWN_possessive] crisp security uniform and heavy baton. [PAWN_pronoun] learned every blind spot and junction inside the vault's steel corridors.

BackstoryDef.title: vault security chief
BackstoryDef.description: Commanding the blue-armored security forces of Vault-Tec, [PAWN_nameDef] enforces order with shotguns, riot gear, and zero patience for dissent. Gruff and fiercely loyal to the Overseers, [PAWN_pronoun] treats every breach as a personal insult.
